questions.question:
After interchanging the given two signs and two numbers, what will be the value of the given equation?

+ and -, 7 and 9 ; 8 × 7 + 9 ÷ 1 - 5
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Given equation is : 8 × 7 + 9 ÷ 1 - 5

After interchanging the two numbers 7 and 9 and two signs + and - the equation is as follows : 8 × 9 - 7 ÷ 1 + 5

= 8 × 9 - __**7 ÷ 1**__ + 5

= __**8 × 9**__ - 7 + 5

= __**72**__ - 7 __**+ 5**__

= __**77 - 7**__

= **70**

Hence, the correct answer is **"70".**

questions.question: Marks of five girls Mansi, Kajal, Reetu, Tina and Riya are compared Marks of Riya are less than Mansi but more than Tina. Marks of Reetu are less than Tina, Riya and Mansi. Marks of Kajal are less than Reetu. Marks of how many girls are less than the marks of Riya?
questions.solution:
Marks of five girls Mansi, Kajal, Reetu, Tina and Riya are compared

1) Marks of Riya are less than Mansi but more than Tina.

Mansi > Riya > Tina

2) Marks of Reetu are less than Tina, Riya and Mansi.

Mansi > Riya > Tina > Reetu

3) Marks of Kajal are less than Reetu.

Mansi > Riya > Tina > Reetu > Kajal

∴ Here, marks of 3 girls are less than the marks of Riya

Hence, the correct answer is** "3".**

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

44 ÷ 11 + 7 × 3 - 19 = 2
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : + and ÷ 

Given equation is : 44 ÷ 11 + 7 × 3 - 19 = 2

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 44 + 11 ÷ 7 × 3 - 19 = 2

⇒ 44 + __**11 ÷ 7**__ × 3 - 19 = 2

⇒ 44 + __**1.57 × 3**__ - 19 = 2

⇒ __**44 + 4.71**__ - 19 = 2

⇒ __**48.71 - 19**__ = 2

⇒ 29.71 ≠ 2

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : - and +

Given equation is : 44 ÷ 11 + 7 × 3 - 19 = 2

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 44 ÷ 11 - 7 × 3 + 19 = 2

⇒ __**44 ÷ 11**__ - 7 × 3 + 19 = 2

⇒ 4 - __**7 × 3**__ + 19 = 2

⇒__** **____**4 **__- 21 __**+ 19 **__= 2

⇒ __**23**____** - 21**__ = 2

**⇒ 2 = 2**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 3) : = and ÷ 

Given equation is : 44 ÷ 11 + 7 × 3 - 19 = 2

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 44 = 11 + 7 × 3 - 19 ÷ 2

⇒ 44 = 11 + 7 × 3 - __**19 ÷ 2**__

⇒ 44 = 11 + __**7 × 3**__ - 9.5

⇒ 44 = __**11 + 21**__ - 9.5

⇒ 44 = __**32 - 9.5**__

⇒ 44 ≠ 22.5

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : - and =

Given equation is : 44 ÷ 11 + 7 × 3 - 19 = 2

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 44 ÷ 11 + 7 × 3 = 19 - 2

⇒ __**44 ÷ 11**__ + 7 × 3 = 19 - 2

⇒ 4 + __**7 × 3**__ = 19 - 2

⇒ __**4 + 21**__ = __**19 - 2**__

⇒ 25 ≠ 17

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"- and +".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number. 

7 : 56 :: 12 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Second number = (First number)2 + First number**

**7 : 56** → 7² + 7 = 49 + 7 = 56

Similarly,

**12 : ? → 12² + 12 = 144 + 12 = 156**

Hence, the correct answer is **"156".**
